1. Preheat the oven (10 to 12 minutes).

3. While you preheat the oven, rub the apple in the bowl with flour, the knife and sugar (8 to 10 minutes).
4. Spread the apple with the baking dish (1 to 2 minutes).
5. Bake the crumble in the oven until it is golden (30 to 35 minutes). It takes 48 to 55 minutes in all.
